gates.evidence: s01 is Home News Feed displaying standard news and top stories like 'Top Stories' and 'Entertainment'.
Reward is '1 Premium Deep-Dive Article' via SIM-RWD; no clicks, installs, or cash-like items are incentivized.
Offer uses standard copy: 'Play a 15-second game to access this in-depth investigative article.' with 'No thanks' decline.
Requires explicit tap on CTA 'Play Now'.
States exact reward ('1 Premium Deep-Dive Article') and required action ('Play a 15-second game').
Provides an equally legible decline option 'No thanks' returning the user to the feed with no penalty.
Triggered only when the user taps an article in the feed marked 'Premium Insight'.

scores.evidence: Proposal: 'User taps an article in the feed marked 'Premium Insight'.'; unlocks an in-depth article. Fits TAX-3 content unlock, though AOL currently has no scarce items.
Proposal adds 'Premium' labels to articles on s01 and locks them behind ads. In a free news app with no prior paywalls, gating news content introduces new friction.
Proposal: 'No paid subscription exists currently to cannibalize; this builds the habit for future monetization.' Rate-limited to 3 per day.
Cost to serve per view is $0.0000; US view earns $0.0090–$0.0150. COGS is well below net revenue per view.
Triggered by tapping premium articles in the Home News Feed (s01), reaching users browsing curated news.
Maps to SIM-RWD with button entry, 15s play, and REWARD_VERIFIED, but requires introducing a new product mechanic and elements.
References s01 and element e38, but introduces an economy item 'PremiumAccess' that does not exist in the baseline product model.
Caps set to 3 per day with a 30-minute cooldown.
Primary metric 'Rewarded engagement rate', guardrails (Article CTR, Retention, Session depth), and a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Exclude the first session from showing rewarded offers on s01 to comply with first-value flow rules.
Clearly define the product change mechanics for introducing gated premium content into a traditionally free news reader without harming user trust.
Properly ground and define the new economy item in the product change specification.
parsed.topConcern: Gating news articles behind rewarded ads in a free news reader app (AOL regime: no-scarcity) risks frustrating users who expect free, unhindered access to news headlines and articles.
